items.title: Over 1,800 Windows Servers Compromised by BADIIS Malware in Large-Scale SEO Poisoning Campaign
items.description: A sophisticated cyber campaign has compromised over 1,800 Windows servers globally, using a potent malware strain known as BADIIS. This operation targets Internet Information Services (IIS) environments, transforming legitimate infrastructure into a massive network for SEO poisoning. By hijacking these servers, threat actors manipulate search engine results to promote illicit gambling platforms…

items.title: CISA Warns of Notepad++ Code Execution Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: CISA has added CVE-2025-15556 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, highlighting active exploitation of a critical code execution flaw in Notepad++, a widely used open-source text editor popular among developers and IT professionals.
